styleReference: Existing original project v1 artwork, redesigned to retain the cartoon medium while replacing the hex badges, dot patterns, compositions and effect silhouettes with aviation radar motifs. No third-party art used as edit input.
normalization: Generated single-icon square PNGs resized to 320px WebP, quality 90. Art redesigned by image_gen; postprocessing only resizes and compresses. No competitor pixels or weapon inventory renders.
scope: Weapon catalog skill tiles, skill hero and base attack preview only. Original PSD card frame and weapon inventory art retained.

assets.name: 速射机炮
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the attached first-version Girl Flight skill tile. Redesign it into an ORIGINAL second-version game icon while preserving the bright hand-drawn 2D cartoon readability, thick navy contour lines and clean 2-3 tone cel shading. REPLACE the entire composition, silhouette and background, not just the color. New art direction: an aviation tactical display with a large expressive skill glyph floating over two thin broken circular radar arcs and a few sparse calibration ticks. Use a cool desaturated blue/slate square background, a soft lighter central field, and a narrow vertical color accent near one side; the glyph itself has vivid family colors and ivory highlights. Open composition, no enclosing badge. The circular radar arcs are faint open lines behind the glyph, never a thick closed medallion. Glyph fills roughly 70% of the tile with an 8% safe margin. Readable at 64px. Keep it playful, illustrated and clean, with no realistic 3D machinery. Strictly remove ALL hexagons, polygon shields, halftone dots, broad diagonal background stripes and original skill silhouette. No text, numbers, logos, outer border or UI controls. Keep square canvas, opaque full-bleed background. New glyph: five short golden tracer streaks in a fan-shaped volley opening upward from one small orange muzzle-flash spark near the lower center. Tracers are chunky glowing dashes with blunt rounded tips, not three realistic cartridge bullets. Mostly upward motion, no single diagonal row. Amber, ivory and navy.
